source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 декабря ст. ст. — «Пророчицы Анны, матери прор. Самуила (1100 до Р.Х.).»

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and the fourth calendar to keep her on this menologion day. Two readings of her stand behind the line, at /Life/life6432.htm and /Life/life3090.htm, reached through the index /Life/id2397.htm. The line’s «(1100 до Р.Х.)» is the first year any of the four calendars has given her and the folder’s `dates` are written from it, under `death` as the corpus already writes the same calendar’s «(XI до Р.Х.)» for her son. The day page prints seven hymns: THREE ARE FOR HER SON, under his name and not hers, two are for the day’s own feast of the conception of the Theotokos and two for an icon, so NONE IS TAKEN HERE.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 decembrie — «Sfânta Prorociță Ana, mama Prorocului Samuel»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Δικαία Άννα η προφήτιδα Μητέρα του προφήτη Σαμουήλ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same woman: the wife of Elkanah and mother of the prophet Samuel. Where doxologia.ro named her and gave no life, this page gives one, so the folder gains its first narrative. It gives no year and no era, so no `dates` object. The same day's calendar also prints «Σύλληψη της Αγίας Άννης», the conception of Saint Anna the mother of the Mother of God; that is a feast and another woman, it is not drafted, and nothing of it is written here. No hymn is printed for the prophetess. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 22.12.2025 (9. децембар ст. ст.) — „Света Ана, матер пророка Самуила.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: `prophetess` is what the other two calendars call her — doxologia.ro «Sfânta Prorociță Ana» and saint.gr «Δικαία Άννα η προφήτιδα» — and this book gives her no rank word at all beyond «Света», so nothing was added and nothing taken away. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND STILL ABSENT: the entry gives no year, no century and no reign, and cites its own source as I Samuel. NO `locations`: «из Арматема или Ариматеје» is the town in two spellings the book itself offers and the folder has never held a coordinate. NO `related` ROW ADDED: `samuel-the-prophet` her son is already `related` here in both directions and is the one person the entry ties her to; Elkanah her husband, Saul and David whom her son anointed are no folders this corpus holds under those names. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: the husband’s name and the town, with the book’s own two spellings of it and its own scriptural citation; that she was barren and grieved and wept bitterly for it; that God loosed her barrenness for her unceasing sighs and prayers; that she dedicated the son to God from his very infancy; and that the song of thanksgiving she sang — wondrous, it says, for its wisdom and its beauty — is still used in the services of the Church to this day. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion, and that song is NOT put in `hymns`: it is a canticle of Scripture the book cites by chapter and verse and does not print, and BRIEF-SERBIAN §3 takes no hymn from this source.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru on the day line: «Пророчицы Анны, матери прор. Самуила (1100 до Р.Х.)». Neither of the source’s two readings of her repeats the figure, and no other calendar the folder cites gives a year; it is recorded under `death` because that is where the corpus already keeps the same calendar’s «(XI до Р.Х.)» for her son.
